label: Thu 19 Nov, 18:30
changes: When you sign in to an account you already have on a device where you played as a guest, your games from that device now come along: solo games, card packs and games with friends. The daily and the Monthly Run stay behind, so nobody gets a second try.
Sign-in fixed: a device that played as a guest can now sign in to an existing account. Email sign-in sends a 6-digit code that you type into the app.
test: On a device where you never signed in: play a solo game as a guest, then Profile → Use email instead → your Gmail address. After the code, the message should say your games came along.
Check the Ranks tab: your username is back and your games are in your stats.
